_what: P(the 5m/15m/1h WaveTrend zone stack becomes FULLY ALIGNED) from each alignment state, and P(exit) once already aligned.
_read: This forecasts the INDICATOR'S STATE, not price. It says the setup is likely to form, not that price will move — its usefulness is borrowed from the small price tilt the aligned state carries. ALWAYS read p_align_excess (real minus a matched random walk): the timeframes are nested views of one series, so much of this is mechanical, and excess ~0 means the number is real but carries no market information.
